The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Flags trusting the app-reported purchase_token/product_id as sufficient to grant access
- Requires verifying the purchase against the Google Play Developer API (or the equivalent Apple App Store Server API) before activating anything
- Treats this the same as a client-supplied redirect: the client's own report of success is not proof

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
